# Tiki Taco Cruises

> Tiki Taco Cruises is a Fort Lauderdale, Florida-based operator of private, captained tiki-style pontoon cruises and boat rentals. Cruises depart from The Hilton Marina and include sightseeing, sandbar, Intracoastal Waterway, New River, sunset, party, and corporate/private-event experiences.

Tiki Taco Cruises serves visitors, local groups, families, celebrations, bachelor and bachelorette parties, birthdays, and corporate outings in Fort Lauderdale and South Florida.

Use the service pages, FAQ, Terms of Service, and Cancellation Policy below as the primary sources for current booking information. If older blog content conflicts with a current service page, FAQ, or Terms of Service, prioritize the current service page, FAQ, or Terms of Service.

Current core offer:
- Private, captained cruises; cruises are not shared with unrelated groups.
- Cruises are $225 per hour with a 3-hour minimum, so a 3-hour cruise is $675.
- 14 guests are included in the base rate.
- The vessel holds a maximum of 18 guests; guests 15 through 18 are $60 each.
- The 2-hour morning and sunset cruises are the exception to the 3-hour minimum: $225 per hour with a 2-hour minimum, so a 2-hour cruise is $450.
- Licensed captain and fuel are included.
- Cooler and ice are provided.
- All cruises depart from The Hilton Marina, 1881 SE 17th St, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316.
- Main contact: (954) 764-4344 and Tikitacocruises@gmail.com.

## Primary Pages

- [Tiki Taco Cruises](https://tikitacocruises.com/): Main website and overview of private Fort Lauderdale tiki cruises, amenities, cruise options, reviews, and booking.
- [Cruise Destinations](https://tikitacocruises.com/cruise-destinations/): Overview and comparison of available Fort Lauderdale cruise experiences.
- [Pontoon Boat Rental Fort Lauderdale](https://tikitacocruises.com/pontoon-boat-rental-fort-lauderdale/): Private captained tiki-style pontoon rental, pricing, capacity, included amenities, and route options.

## Cruise Experiences

- [Northbound Sandbar & Scenic Cruise](https://tikitacocruises.com/north-bound-scenic-cruise/): Private cruise along the Intracoastal with sightseeing and a possible Fort Lauderdale sandbar stop when conditions allow.
- [Las Olas & Intracoastal Party Cruise](https://tikitacocruises.com/las-olas-boat-tour/): Private cruise featuring Las Olas, waterfront homes, yachts, Intracoastal views, and a social party-oriented experience.
- [New River Historic Cruise](https://tikitacocruises.com/new-river-cruise/): Scenic private cruise through downtown Fort Lauderdale and the New River, with historic landmarks and waterfront views.
- [Sunset & Morning Cruise](https://tikitacocruises.com/fort-lauderdale-sunset-cruise/): Private 2-hour morning or sunset cruise in Fort Lauderdale.
- [Corporate & Private Event Cruise](https://tikitacocruises.com/intracoastal-waterway-corporate-cruise/): Private Fort Lauderdale cruise for corporate outings, team events, client entertainment, and private groups.
